verdict.rationale: Supabase documents Database Webhooks as a first-party feature. They send HTTP requests with event payloads to any endpoint whenever a table INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE occurs, built on triggers and pg_net, so a programmatic consumer can register an outbound callback. Coverage is limited to database table events. missing for 10: webhooks for non-database platform events (auth, storage, project/management events), documented delivery guarantees/retries and payload signing, independent or hands-on corroboration.
